== English Special Edition comparison ==
The original says Yavin 4 Sentry. Decipher's replacement names Yavin Sentry, the matching Effect's title. Grondorn's presence on Yavin 4 and the rest of his game text are unaffected. The Players Committee slips and rulebook repeat the Decipher wording.

[https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=4 Decipher, Glossary Supplement, 29 January 2002], PDF page 4. [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=19 Players Committee, Decipher Errata, text as of 1 January 2013], PDF page 19. [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=114 Players Committee, Advanced Rulebook, 2023, Appendix A], PDF page 114.
